author: (Günther, 1880)

note.en: A 10 cm whiff of deep soft bottoms, mostly at 140 to 400 m, known here from a University of Costa Rica trawl at 110 m off Limón in 1968.
note.es: Un lenguado de 10 cm de fondos blandos profundos, sobre todo entre 140 y 400 m, conocido aquí por un arrastre de la Universidad de Costa Rica a 110 m frente a Limón en 1968.

evidence: OBIS: 1 record, University of Costa Rica, 2 miles north of Limón at 110 m (1968)
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010)

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 190-193 (Paralichthyidae)

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: OBIS: 1 record, University of Costa Rica, 2 miles north of Limón at 110 m (1968).
